```yaml
name: DDL Execution Review
on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main, dev]
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]

jobs:
  code-review:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '18'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          npm ci
          npm install @liam-hq/pglite-server

      - name: Run ESLint
        run: npm run lint

      - name: Run tests
        run: npm test

      - name: Validate DDL Implementation
        run: |
          echo "Validating DDL execution implementation..."
          # Check if executeDDLNode.ts exists and has proper implementation
          if [ -f "src/nodes/executeDDLNode.ts" ]; then
            echo "executeDDLNode.ts found"
            # Basic validation of key components
            grep -q "executeQuery" src/nodes/executeDDLNode.ts && echo "executeQuery found" || echo "WARNING: executeQuery not found"
            grep -q "ddlStatements" src/nodes/executeDDLNode.ts && echo "ddlStatements found" || echo "WARNING: ddlStatements not found"
            grep -q "designSessionId" src/nodes/executeDDLNode.ts && echo "designSessionId found" || echo "WARNING: designSessionId not found"
          else
            echo "ERROR: executeDDLNode.ts not found"
            exit 1
          fi
          
          # Check if dependency is added
          if npm list @liam-hq/pglite-server; then
            echo "@liam-hq/pglite-server dependency found"
          else
            echo "ERROR: @liam-hq/pglite-server dependency not found"
            exit 1
          fi
```
